name: Teterboro Landing
summary: Teterboro Landing is a commercial development on Industrial Avenue in Teterboro, NJ, developed by Catellus Development Corporation. Strategically located near Teterboro Airport and major transportation routes, it serves the surrounding industrial corridor and Bergen County communities with convenient retail and service options.
demographics: Teterboro Landing attracts a professional demographic primarily consisting of business travelers, logistics professionals, and industrial workers given its location in Teterboro's industrial corridor near major transportation hubs. The trade area serves middle to upper-middle income households from surrounding Bergen County communities, with visitors typically ranging from 25-55 years old. The center caters to convenience-oriented shoppers seeking quick service options during work hours, as well as employees from nearby office parks and distribution facilities who value accessible amenities close to their workplaces.
description: Teterboro Landing is a strategically positioned commercial development located on Industrial Avenue in Teterboro, New Jersey, developed by Catellus Development Corporation. Situated in one of Bergen County's key industrial and logistics corridors, this center serves the unique needs of the surrounding business community and nearby residential areas. The property benefits from its proximity to Teterboro Airport and major highway access, making it an ideal destination for professionals and residents seeking convenient retail and service options. Developed by Catellus, a respected real estate development company with a portfolio of mixed-use and commercial projects across the country, Teterboro Landing represents a modern approach to community-oriented retail in an industrial setting. With a solid 4.5-star rating from visitors, the center has established itself as a reliable destination that successfully balances the needs of the local workforce with quality tenant offerings and accessible location advantages.
